title: Claim-level provenance and reusability of cell-composition estimands in single-cell disease studies
description: Frozen derived claim-level provenance audit and reproducible software for 50 composition claims from 19 human single-cell disease papers and 18 cohorts. Includes provenance classes and node statuses, cohort relationships, marginal and nested closure summaries, paper- and cohort-clustered bootstrap summaries, corpus-flow records, search strategy, documentation, portable numerical checks and figure-generation code. The resource measures reconstructability under a bounded public-source search. The four frozen classes contain 0 fully reusable, 13 partially reusable, 5 source-supported non-reusable and 32 unresolved claims. Raw sequencing files, third-party expression matrices, article PDFs and participant-level objects are not included.
